page.overview:
Who is Ganzui?

Ganzui was a member of the Rocks Pirates. A smuggler by trade, he lost a Davy Back Fight and subsequently joined Rocks in his pursuits.

Sometime after the God Valley Incident, he perished, and his corpse was subsequently retrieved and revived by Gecko Moria as Zombie #889, a General Zombie.

In life, Ganzui was a man of great size, showcasing a wide build, with massive hands and forearms. His head was somewhat small in comparison, with a wide mouth, sunglasses, a long ponytail, and a very long beard. His hair and beard were reddish-brown in color (black in the anime). He wore a bulky golden suit of armor, with a cape. 42 years ago, he had ditched his glasses and wore a golden helmet. At some point after God Valley and prior his death, he fully grew out his mustache.

As a zombie, his lower body is shown to that of an elephant's, making him a centaur. In addition, his body was covered with bandages, and his armor was branded with his number, 889. He also appears to have lost his left eye and two of his front teeth.
